PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY.description: Secret key for session tokens and signing. Auto-generated on first deploy.

PAPERLESS_REDIS.description: Redis connection string for Celery broker. Auto-detected from the Redis companion service (REDIS_URL).

PAPERLESS_DBHOST.description: PostgreSQL host. Auto-detected from the Postgres companion service (PGHOST).

PAPERLESS_DBPORT.description: PostgreSQL port. Auto-detected from the Postgres companion service (PGPORT).

PAPERLESS_DBNAME.description: PostgreSQL database name. Auto-detected from the Postgres companion service (PGDATABASE).

PAPERLESS_DBUSER.description: PostgreSQL username. Auto-detected from the Postgres companion service (PGUSER).

PAPERLESS_DBPASS.description: PostgreSQL password. Auto-detected from the Postgres companion service (PGPASSWORD).

PAPERLESS_DB_OPTIONS.description: PostgreSQL connection options (JSON). Sets SSL mode to prefer.

PAPERLESS_URL.description: Public URL for Paperless-ngx. Auto-configured via Railway public domain.

PAPERLESS_OCR_LANGUAGE.description: Default language for OCR. Set to the language most of your documents are written in.

PAPERLESS_OCR_LANGUAGES.description: Additional OCR languages to install, space-separated.

PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_RECURSIVE.description: Whether the document consumer recursively scans subdirectories.

PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_POLLING_INTERVAL.description: Polling interval (seconds) for the consumer. 0 = event-driven (recommended).

PORT.description: Port for the Paperless-ngx web server.
